subject.title: Bug: 升级后 Dashboard 历史会话索引/映射错乱

question: Should OpenClaw add a doctor or migration repair that relinks corrupted Dashboard session rows to preserved transcript or trajectory files, and what evidence is sufficient for a safe relink?
rationale: The source path confirms the reported corrupted store shape would still load the wrong history, but deciding when it is safe to rewrite user session state requires product/data-repair policy to avoid attaching a Dashboard key to the wrong preserved file.

options.title: Conservative Doctor Repair
options.body: Implement a doctor/migration repair only when transcript headers, stored `sessionFile`, session key ownership, and trajectory metadata all identify the same preserved session; leave ambiguous cases diagnostic-only.

options.title: Diagnostic Only
options.body: Add detection that reports the mismatch and asks the user for a redacted fixture or manual confirmation before relinking any session state.

options.title: Manual Recovery Only
options.body: Document the recovery path and leave automatic relinking unsupported because wrong repairs could be worse than the existing mismatch.

recommendation.title: Conservative Doctor Repair
recommendation.body: Implement a doctor/migration repair only when transcript headers, stored `sessionFile`, session key ownership, and trajectory metadata all identify the same preserved session; leave ambiguous cases diagnostic-only.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent merged transcript-reader identity work owns the read boundary that any safe repair needs to feed without reintroducing file-path identity assumptions.
